questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Ramya is working / hardly / to get good marks.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**hardly**."
 
• The word "**hardly**" means "barely" or "scarcely," which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct word should be "**hard**" to convey that Ramya is putting in a lot of effort.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Ramya is working **hard** to get good marks."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramya is working** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **to get good marks** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 1.

questions.question:
Identify the error in the given sentence and select the correct sentence from the given options.

options.text: Petrified wood is a type of fossilised wood that exhibits the original details of the wood.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**a**" before the term "**type of fossilised wood**."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article ("a" or "an").
 
• The correct phrase should be "**a type of fossilised wood**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the original sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Petrified wood is a type of fossilised wood that exhibits the original details of the wood."*

• **Option 3: "The petrified wood is the type of fossilised wood that exhibits a original details of the wood."** – This option incorrectly uses "The petrified wood" and "a original details."
 
• **Option 4: "Petrified wood is the type of fossilised wood that exhibits a original details of the wood."** – This option incorrectly uses "the type" and "a original details."

questions.question:
Select the appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Last resort
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **'****Last course of action****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Last resort"** means the final course of action that one takes when all other options have failed. (आखिरी उपाय)

 
 
• **Example:** When all negotiations failed, the company had to take legal action as a **last resort**.
 
 
 
• **"Last course of action"** refers to the final option available when all other methods have been exhausted. (अंतिम उपाय)
 
 
• **Example:** As a **last course of action**, they decided to evacuate the building.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Last hotel on the way** (रास्ते में आखिरी होटल): The final hotel available on a route.

 
 
• **Example:** We stayed at **the last hotel on the way** before reaching our destination.
 
 
 
• **Last friend remaining** (आखिरी दोस्त बचा हुआ): The final friend left in a group.
 
 
• **Example:** He was my **last friend remaining** from our school days.
 
 
 
• **Last ride** (अंतिम सवारी): The final ride or journey.
 
 
• **Example:** We took our **last ride** together before he moved to another city.
